notes: Page 73. Day 18 (Romanus the monk) ends: doxology ¶፳፰, then arke (Ge'ez only). Ge'ez ¶፳፬ continuation begins unnumbered and joins p072 ending "ለእመ፡" with a space. Amharic opening "ግድ…" joins p072 "…እንሰ" with NO space (እንሰግድ). Numerals ፳፭–፳፰ read from scan (small, partly dotted; Ge'ez ፳፭ and Amharic ፳፭ blurred, inferred from sequence). UNCERTAIN: Ge'ez ¶፳፮ read as one paragraph incl. "አሜሃ ተወህቦ…"; "ሞቅሕ"; "አገዝዘ"; "ምታረ"; "ኢተመትረ"; "ዘኢመተርከ"; "ወእንዘ ይዝልፎ". Doxology Ge'ez "በጸሎቱ ለዝንቱ መስተጋድል": scan reads "በጸሎቱ ለገንቱ መስታጋድል" (corrected by pattern, p066 has "ለዝንቱ አብ መስተጋድል"). Ge'ez "አስትዪኒ"; "ጸማዕኩ" (scan ጸማዕኩ). Amharic "ያመጡ ዘንድ እዘዝ" (maybe ያመጡ/ያምጡ), "ወህኒ", "ተጠምቻለሁና". Arke: "ዚአሁ", "ካዓድ", "ንዑስ ወልድ" and the 3rd-4th line seams read from a wide crop; "እምነ" maybe "እመነ". Arke refers to the child ("ንዑስ ወልድ") whose name is not given.
